issue.title: Do not treat SQLite read errors as zero pending uploads [Returning online and sync changes Audit]
issue.body:
Found during the returning online and synchronizing changes audit (#530, epic #526). Deferred from PR #563 (CodeRabbit review thread on `src/db/queries.ts`, still open).

**Severity:** Medium  
**Launch blocker:** No  
**Confirmed on:** code review of `main` (not reproducible on device without forcing a database read failure)

## Summary

The pending-upload queries swallow database errors and return zero: `getPendingUploadCount()` (`src/db/queries.ts:639`) and `getUnuploadablePendingSummary()` (`:677`) catch and return `0` / an empty summary, and `loadPendingUploadCount()` (`src/hooks/usePendingUploads.ts:24`) does the same for the log-out guard. When a read fails, the Sync page derives `uploadComplete` and shows "All synced", and log out skips the unsynced-work warning. PR #606 moves the hook into a shared store but does not change the queries, so the store receives `0` as a valid count.

## Expected

A failed read is shown as unknown or error, never as "All synced", and the log-out guard does not treat it as "nothing pending".

## Actual

A failed read is indistinguishable from zero pending uploads.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Pending-count queries propagate failures (or return an explicit unknown state) instead of `0`.
- [ ] The Sync page does not show "All synced" or `uploadComplete` when counts are unknown.
- [ ] The log-out guard treats an unknown count as "may have unsynced work".
- [ ] Unit tests: query failure → no `uploadComplete`, and the log-out warning is shown.

## Related

- Parent audit: #530 (epic #526)
- PR #563 (deferral), #603 / PR #606 (shared store)
- Assessment: `docs/assessments/returning-online-and-sync/README.md` (PR #598)
